entities.summary: Henry Robert Nicollon des Abbayes was a French botanist and lichenologist. He was the chair of the Botanical Department of the University of Rennes and an expert on plants of Brittany and the flora of Great Britain. The standard author abbreviation Abbayes is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
